title: Week 12 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “due process”?
options: A plan for measuring whether a policy caused intended results and what else occurred.
Displacement of state or local law by valid federal law.
Constitutional requirements of fair law, notice, procedure, and impartial decision-making before government deprives life, liberty, or property.
A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.
questions.explanation: Due process means constitutional requirements of fair law, notice, procedure, and impartial decision-making before government deprives life, liberty, or property.
